python3 -c "
import pymupdf, json

src_doc = pymupdf.open('/Users/tranhaibang/Downloads/Test/21_R5_JSTB_mongolia.pdf')
tgt_doc = pymupdf.open('/Users/tranhaibang/Downloads/Test/21_R5_JSTB_mongolia_VI.pdf')

pages_data = []
for pno in range(len(src_doc)):
    src_page = src_doc[pno]
    tgt_page = tgt_doc[pno]
    
    src_blocks = src_page.get_text('blocks')
    tgt_blocks = tgt_page.get_text('blocks')
    
    page_item = {
        'page': pno + 1,
        'width': src_page.rect.width,
        'height': src_page.rect.height,
        'source_block_count': len(src_blocks),
        'target_block_count': len(tgt_blocks),
        'combined_text_source': src_page.get_text().strip(),
        'combined_text_target': tgt_page.get_text().strip(),
        'blocks': []
    }
    
    for i, sb in enumerate(src_blocks):
        tb_text = tgt_blocks[i][4].strip() if i < len(tgt_blocks) else ''
        page_item['blocks'].append({
            'block_id': i + 1,
            'bbox': list(sb[:4]),
            'source_text': sb[4].strip(),
            'translated_text': tb_text
        })
    pages_data.append(page_item)

with open('_process/retain_pdf_T02_medical_report/merged_ejv.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({
        'document': '21_R5_JSTB_mongolia.pdf',
        'domain': 'Thận học & Kỹ thuật Lọc máu Ngoài cơ thể',
        'source_lang': 'ja',
        'target_lang': 'vi',
        'total_pages': len(src_doc),
        'pages': pages_data
    }, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

print('Generated merged_ejv.json with', len(pages_data), 'pages.')
